'''Hunvar''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] based in [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. The floor of [[Hunvar's Spire|his residence's]] dining hall had a hole through which spectators could watch slaves engaged in combat for their entertainment. Hunvar was rumored to be in possession of a lost [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], but this was in fact a hoax promulgated by slavery opponents in an attempt to publicize the plight of enslaved [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|females]].<ref name="GatORW" />
